# Brain (try4ever.com)

Brain is a study tool by try4ever that turns PDFs, DOCX, TXT and EPUB files into an interactive 3D knowledge map in the browser. Files are processed entirely on the user's device — no upload, no account database, no tracking. Free plan by application ($0/mo), paid plan $19/mo, 7-day no-card trial. App lives at https://brain.try4ever.com.

## Pages

- [Brain – Turn PDFs & Notes Into a 3D Study Map](https://try4ever.com/): Turn PDFs & notes into a 3D knowledge map you can study from. 7-day trial, no card. Free plan by application; $19/mo instant. Files never leave your device.
- [How Brain Works – From Upload to 3D Knowledge Map](https://try4ever.com/how/): Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT or EPUB, watch it become a 3D graph of topics, quiz yourself, and track mastery from red to green. On-device processing, step by step.
- [Features – 3D Map, Mastery Tracking, Quizzes, Offline](https://try4ever.com/features/): A 3D knowledge map, color-coded mastery, quiz generation, offline mode and on-device file processing. Everything runs in your browser – no cloud, no tracking.
